source: Adams et al. 2025 Ecology, Figshare original station-year RDS 10.6084/m9.figshare.26050390.v2
parent_source_grain: 833 site-years, 53 radar stations, 2003-2018; previously verified 828 complete model cases
scientific_question: In the original radar station-year records, how often had MODIS mean greenup already happened by the date of median spring bird passage, before any 0- or 7-day sensing/processing lag?
prefit_biological_target: Temporal ordering of retrospective median greenup DOY and radar spring 50%-passage DOY; NOT behavior, belief, payoff, causal cue availability, or real-time operational forecast
sample_rule: Exact same 828 complete-case site-years as prior PR #415: require nonmissing spring_q50, spring_mean_temp, and mean_greenup; do not choose missingness based on timing outcome
contrast: delta_days = spring_q50 - mean_greenup; positive means mean greenup preceded median passage

three_class_ordering.exact_calendar_tie: delta_days == 0 (day precision; do not claim greenup known at the same time)

fixed_lag_sensitivity.zero_day_optimistic: delta_days >= 0 (even a same-calendar-day match is only an optimistic ordering upper bound)
fixed_lag_sensitivity.one_day_prior: delta_days >= 1 (greenup had to precede median passage by a full day)
fixed_lag_sensitivity.seven_days_prior: delta_days >= 7 (sensitivity for combined detection/processing/response latency; not a measured satellite delivery lag)

aggregate_outputs: pooled n and fraction for three temporal-ordering classes
16 annual aggregate counts, never site names or original rows
equal-year mean fractions and 95% year-resampling bootstrap intervals
number of years with >50% median passage preceding greenup

uncertainty.interpretation: conditional exploratory across observed years; 16 folds are not independent studies

decision: Descriptive temporal-support audit; report both directions including negative results, no p-value test or threshold tuning, never promote to cue use or causal phenological tracking
fail_closed: original SHA256 mismatches or source not accessible
site-year duplicate or any unexpected source grain
nonfinite or invalid DOY (>366 or <1), or year out of 2003-2018
unintended use of eBird or cross-source join
causal_limits: Retrospective MODIS mean greenup DOY is not what any bird necessarily perceived
Weather radar 50% passage timing is an assemblage statistic, not an individual decision time
Greenup can be sensed gradually, earlier than the final estimated timing marker; event ordering is a strict proxy, not a necessary condition for any cue
Satellite algorithm and data product latency are not observed, so 0-day is optimistic and 7-day is illustrative, not an actual issue-time forecast
No biomass, insect resource, fitness, adaptation, animal beliefs, or partner coordination is measured
Adams 2025 already published climate-greenup-passage results; this is retrospective reanalysis and not new biological replication
Previous no-robust-greenup-prediction result remains unchanged; do not reopen the model
